referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a exhaust air system for kitchens in appartment buildings. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is an estimate based on a study of an exhaust air system for kitchen and bathrooms of one large appartment building with a heated gross floor area of 30800 m2.The inventory includes materials needed for fans and ducts. The data represents ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel. It includes duct fans and radial fans without heat recovery and a nominal air flow rate of 500-5700 m3/h per unit.; UUID: dd696759-bc88-48b7-b41c-18a5e91bfb5d
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Metals not included (Cut-off to recycling). For other materials: transport to dismantling facilities, machines for handling in sorting plant, electricity demand for sorting plant, final disposal of waste material.

technology.text: Cut-off to recycling for all metals, disposal to a sorting plant for other materials assumed. plastic parts are incinerated, inert wastes (e.g. rock wool) are landfilled.
